title: Trace an async call and its continuation
scopeNote: Node.js ESM examples of synchronous call prefixes and await continuations. These teaching surfaces are separate from the calibrated assessment cases; stages are optional teaching choices, not a mandatory sequence.

worked_example.teacherNotes: Explain each labeled subgoal. Optional principle answer: Promise.resolve(0) still suspends at await, so printer:released stays after desk:free. Showing this example is instruction, not clean retrieval evidence.

completion.teacherNotes: Solution: stamp:cyan, receipt:promise=true, counter:open, result:sealed. The call runs its prefix immediately and returns a promise when stamp suspends. Top-level synchronous logs run before the final await receives sealed. Ask for the boundary reason, not only the trace. Use completion-solution.mjs to verify; keep this answer key out of the learner prompt.
